title: Arena Carve and Reset
prompt: Implement a tiny linear arena: `Arena(bytes)` owns a buffer; `carve(n)` returns a pointer into it (16-byte aligned) or `nullptr` if `n` does not fit; `reset()` makes the whole buffer reusable; `used()` reports allocated bytes.

tests.name: carve hands out aligned, non-overlapping ranges
tests.hint: Round the offset up to the next multiple of 16 (padding counts toward used()), return buf_ + offset, advance offset by n.

tests.name: reset restores capacity
tests.hint: reset() sets offset_ back to 0 — carve succeeds again after reset. The alignment rule: round the offset up to a multiple of 16 BEFORE handing out the pointer.
